links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: I think maybe we could make the ninth? I'd have to check with design, they might be-

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Check today.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Yeah. Yeah, will do.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Do we even need new artwork? It's the same product line as Lyon back in June.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: New artwork. Next. Expense tool.

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: Cutover's the first of October.

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: Get September claims in by the twenty-sixth.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Is that a Friday?

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: Yes.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Sorry. Twenty-sixth. Got it.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: I think it's around eleven thousand? Maybe eleven two with the platform fee, but I'd want to double check that.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Send it by Thursday.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Sure, yeah.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Is that with the captioning or without?

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: So, okay, this has been rattling around since the debrief. What if there just isn't a central one next year, and instead it's three one-day regional roadshows, Manchester, Frankfurt and Austin?

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Why?

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Because look at last year. We put 180,000 dollars into customer travel subsidies and only 34 percent of target accounts actually turned up.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Whereas with those three cities most of them are a short trip away, a train or a quick hop, not a whole week gone out of the office.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Okay, but hang on, is that a distance problem? Maybe they just didn't fancy coming.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Some of them, sure, but I went through the decline emails after the debrief and it's, you know, can't get the trip approved, over and over.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: How many is over and over?

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: I didn't count, I just-

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Because three emails from Ohio isn't a trend.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: It was a lot more than three.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Count them.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Yep. Fine.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: I think, um, maybe that subsidy line drops a lot with it? Like if they're on a train there's not much to subsidise. But I'd be guessing.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Sure, that one drops, but then you've got three venues, three AV crews, three of everything. The money doesn't vanish, it just moves.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Does it?

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Possibly? I think maybe one day in a hotel ballroom isn't that bad, but I haven't priced any of it, so.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: And there's five of us. Who's carrying boxes to Austin?

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Well, we'd space them out, it's not like they'd be back to back, and a one-day thing is honestly so much lighter than-

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Lighter times three, though.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Okay, lighter times three, but still.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: And the execs. Getting the CEO to all of those?

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: Last year she stayed forty minutes.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Oh, and that reminds me, the lanyards, did I ever tell you what actually happened with the lanyards?

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Is this relevant?

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: It's a little bit relevant. So the courier sends the box to the wrong Hartwell, right, the airport one, and I'm on the phone to this lovely man called Gerald-

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: There's always a Gerald.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: There is, and Gerald says he can see the box, he's looking at it, but he can't release it without a form from the sender, and the sender's closed because it's a Sunday in, um, in wherever they are-

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Wasn't it you who drove out there in the end?

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: That was Priya, she took her husband's van, and she came back with twelve hundred lanyards and a parking ticket, and we're still arguing with finance about that ticket, I think it's in the shoebox actually.

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: It is not in the expense policy.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: It is not, no, thank you, Ingrid.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Back to it. Kofi, what else?

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: The room. Half the point of getting everyone together is customers meeting other customers. A German bank doesn't meet the guy from Texas if they're never in one place.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Do they want to, though?

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Some do. The user group people do, they talk about it all year.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: I think that's maybe fair, but, I mean, a third of the accounts isn't much of a big room either.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: A third's still a room.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: A very expensive room.

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: Frankfurt would need its own registration notice. German wording, data handling, that sort of thing.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Hard?

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: No. Two weeks with legal, maybe.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Fine. Tariq, where are you on it?

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: I think I'm probably for it? As long as, you know, the costs don't come back ugly. It seems like it gets in front of more of the people we actually care about.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Ingrid?

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: For it.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Kofi, are you actually against this?

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Not really. I just think somebody should be.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Right. That's it, then. Next year's summit runs as the three regional roadshows, Manchester, Frankfurt, Austin.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Yes. Okay. Great.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Tariq, rough costs for it before planning opens.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Yep. I think maybe a first pass by the end of next week? It'll be rough.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Rough is fine. Sofia, those emails.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Counting them, yes.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Ingrid, have a word with legal about that notice.

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: Okay.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Do I get anything?

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: You get the holiday party.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: That's a punishment.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Yes. Facilities need a headcount by mid-October.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Is it the same place as last year? Because the coat check there was a disaster, I was in that queue for, I swear, forty-five minutes, and-

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: I'll find out.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: I think maybe somebody said they'd closed down? Or was that the other one, the one near the station.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: The other one, I think.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Also the desk move. We're on the third floor from the sixth of October, pack by the Friday before.

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: Crates arrive when?

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Monday before, supposedly.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Supposedly, right. Gerald's probably delivering them.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: To the wrong Hartwell.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Tariq, Hamburg artwork. Today.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Yes. Doing it now, actually, I'll just-

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Good. We're done.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Crates. Who's got theirs?

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Take one. Packed by Friday.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Get one.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Expense tool. Tomorrow, yes?

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: Anything not in by six goes through the new one.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Good. Webinar number went to finance?

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Two and a bit.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Sofia. The emails.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: End of the week.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: End of the week, yep.

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: That number doesn't care how many cities we went to. Fifty-eight soft yeses out of a hundred and forty, and Frankfurt costing more before we've signed anything. I don't see how that gets us to one point two. These roadshows could miss it.

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: No. It's what we've got, though.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: I think she's maybe got a point. Like, I said I was for it as long as the costs didn't come back ugly, and I don't know yet that they're ugly, but it's, um, it's a bit less pretty than it was.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Who owns that number?

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: And it's not like one big room was hitting it by magic, is it? I mean, did we hit it last year? With the thirty-four percent?

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Enough. We don't have the numbers to have this properly.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: I think maybe if I get the costs done, and, um, the Frankfurt quote in there, at the higher figure, that at least-

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Yes. Higher figure.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Yep. Will do.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Nothing's changed today. It's still the three roadshows until somebody shows me otherwise. But I've heard you, Ingrid.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Don't go telling sales it's wobbling.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Same venue's still open, so that was the other one that closed, Tariq was half right. They want a headcount by the fifteenth.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: And the coat check? Because if it's the same people I'm bringing my coat to the table and I don't care who-

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: I asked. They said they've 'looked at the process.'

links.speaker: Ingrid
links.quote: Is the fifteenth a Wednesday?

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Fine. Third floor Monday. Laptops stay with you, don't crate them.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: We're done.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Right. Summit. You've all had a week with Kofi's numbers, so I'm opening it back up. Is the format right or isn't it?

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Well, there you go.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Oh. Okay. Yeah. No, fine, okay.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Friday, yeah. Friday night, sorry. The AV quotes came in, so I think everything's there now, and Frankfurt's at the higher figure, like you said.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Done. Sixty-three, Kofi. Sixty-three separate people saying they couldn't get the trip signed off, and that's not counting the ones who just wrote 'budget' and nothing else.

links.speaker: Kofi
links.quote: Okay. More than three.

links.speaker: Sofia
links.quote: Thank you. I'd like that minuted.
